paragraphs: greehill turns an urban forest into a continuously updated, predictive system that reveals the condition of every tree and anticipates risk early. The company captures street-level tree data, builds verified digital twins, and turns them into operational metrics and predictive signals across streets, parks, and districts. LiDAR scanning, AI analysis, and operational workflows connect in one system for predicting change and managing trees every day.

Cities are the buyer named on these pages, and greehill works with cities across nearly all continents, creating verified, citywide tree inventories. Within those cities the pages name arborists who inspect trees every day, commissioners who approve budgets and answer to the public, and infrastructure teams who need facts. The output is described as more than 70 measurable metrics, from field operations to city-level planning, reporting, and infrastructure investment.

Cities choose how to execute: in-house, with existing partners, or with regional greehill partners, while the system, the data standard, and quality assurance remain with greehill. Cities worldwide use it in daily operations to manage urban infrastructure from capitals to regional districts.

quote.text: What if your city could understand every tree as part of a living system?
